data.narrative:
MightyFly is a Series A-stage company in the Drones & Autonomous sector, founded by Manal Habib, having raised $10M to date. The valuation universe comprises 8 private peers in the broader sector, including companies like Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, Archer Aviation, and Elroy Air. No public comparables exist in this subsector.

Valuation analysis was conducted using stage-progression methodology, as peer-median triangulation was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the Drones & Autonomous universe (0 same-stage peers, 1 adjacent-stage peer, and 0 similar-tier peers identified—below the minimum threshold of 3 datapoints). The stage-progression method applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier from Series A to the next anticipated funding stage, using the $10M total raised as a baseline proxy. This implies a valuation of $20M.

The analysis supports a range of $17M to $23M, with a median of $20M. This narrow band reflects the single-method foundation and should be interpreted with caution given the sparse comparable set. Key uncertainties include the absence of same-stage peer data, which limits benchmarking precision, and the nascent state of autonomous systems commercialization, which may render historical stage-progression multiples unreliable. Investors should prioritize operational milestones and technology differentiation when assessing fair value within this range.
